name: rsu-two-protected-zones-extension-forms
reference: Values chosen; encoded as the PDU type CAM of the ASN.1 module CAM-PDU-Descriptions (ETSI EN 302 637-2 v1.4.1, forge.etsi.org cam_en302637_2 commit fed28cfe5c930dd9d3109ff1162c28008697754a) with ITS-Container (TS 102 894-2 v1.3.1, commit 2d2450e79aab4c7032ef615b72ddefaf2e5ba8a9) by two independent UPER codecs that agree byte for byte: asn1tools 0.169.0 (MIT, PyPI), codec uper, and pycrate 0.8.1 (LGPL, PyPI), to_uper. A roadside-unit CAM (stationType 15): HighFrequencyContainer alternative 1, rsuContainerHighFrequency with its extension bit 0 and presence bit 1, two ProtectedCommunicationZone items (count 2 - 1 in 4 bits). Zone 1: presence 111, protectedZoneType temporaryCenDsrcTolling in the extension form (bit 1, normally small 0 = 0000000; decodes as 1 + 0 = 1), expiryTime 3000000000000 in 42 bits (top bit set), radius 300 in the extension form (bit 1, length 2, 012c), protectedZoneID 77. Zone 2: presence 010, permanentCenDsrcTolling (bit 0 and an index of 0 bits), radius 50 in the root form (bit 0, 49 in 8 bits). 453 bits, padded to 57 octets. Checked against the pack's lines by a standalone reader and writer of them (Python standard library); derived without an engine.
